settings.reference: GLORYS reanalysis, harmonised to the 0.25 degree grid

bootstrap.kind: moving-block bootstrap over the days of each period
bootstrap.year_difference: 2024 minus 2023 uses independent resamples of the two years

settings.established: interval excludes zero AND the per-seed RMSE ranges do not overlap

argo.interpolation: as validate-argo (eval/argo_validation.py); same cell, same UTC day
argo.note: GLORYS assimilates Argo and the model is trained on GLORYS: not an independent error estimate; GLORYS-vs-Argo is the reference floor.
